subject.title: fix(approvals): fail closed plugin tool gates

question: Should existing plugins that set `requireApproval.timeoutBehavior: "allow"` lose timeout execution authority immediately while the field remains accepted for one deprecation release train?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound and closes real authorization gaps, but it deliberately trades an accepted plugin behavior for a stronger execution-security boundary.

options.title: Accept fail-closed cutover
options.body: Merge after the stack is green, retain the field only for parsing compatibility, and document that unresolved approvals never execute.

options.title: Stage strict behavior
options.body: Preserve timeout allow temporarily and introduce an explicit strict path until upgrade evidence supports changing the default.

options.title: Pause for combined transition
options.body: Wait for the remaining durable approval and exec fallback work so the authorization change can be reviewed as one release transition.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed cutover
recommendation.body: Merge after the stack is green, retain the field only for parsing compatibility, and document that unresolved approvals never execute.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced and recently maintained the shared approval paths and is the strongest history-backed owner for the compatibility and security-boundary decision.
